task.title: Review DAG Lite context optimization
task.description: Independent reviews of the development-only context router layered onto the existing DAG. Current evidence: pnpm dag:test 42/42 PASS; pnpm quality:check PASS (380 tests, typecheck, build); syntax and git diff checks PASS; legacy and optimized Orders smoke both reached 5/5 DONE; existing demo rerun reached 5/5 DONE after clarifying its static report contract. Inspect only tooling files declared by these nodes and ignore unrelated pre-existing dirty CRM files. This task changes no deployable artifact, and production deployment or UI smoke is not applicable.

nodes.title: Compatibility contract review
nodes.description: Review only the DAG context-tooling diff and verify that node states, scheduling, worktrees, integration and product runtime remain compatible. The root AGENTS.md expansion is explicitly required by the user task.

nodes.title: Regression review
nodes.description: Review context routing, budgets, cache invalidation, CLI compatibility, telemetry, safe fallbacks, and existing DAG algorithms. DAG tests and both modes of read-only smoke passed outside the reviewer sandbox.
acceptance_criteria: Verify fallbacks are not single points of failure

nodes.title: Business and security review
nodes.description: Verify business rules are untouched and inspect process, worktree, prompt, secret and approval safety.

nodes.title: Visual applicability review
nodes.description: Confirm whether any user-visible UI changed and whether visual validation is applicable.

nodes.title: Release gate
nodes.description: Review prior findings and supplied quality evidence. This tooling is not to be deployed; decide local completion readiness only.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm blockers or PASS with evidence
